FN-PSSNYER-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 212
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/21/2025
Senate Bill 212 as passed the Senate would codify the existing practice of the Alabama Real
Estate Commission regarding the bad check fee charged by the commission and could increase
the receipts of the commission by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of fines
imposed for disciplinary violations up to $5,000, as authorized by this bill.
